name: Wazuh · Alert Triage
description: Polls the Wazuh indexer every 5 min for level 12+ alerts. Fingerprints, suppresses, dedupes and collapses bursts, enriches source IPs (AbuseIPDB), LLM-triages the rest and only pages Discord on escalations. Daily digest of noisy rules.

parameters.query: SELECT fingerprint, srcip, count, verdict, first_seen, last_seen, notified, fp_percent, summary, intel, suppress_hint FROM wazuh_alerts WHERE last_seen >= now() - interval '24 hours';

INSERT INTO wazuh_alerts AS w (fingerprint, rule_id, level, description, agent, srcip, "user", groups, first_seen, last_seen, count, verdict, reason, fp_percent, summary, intel, suppress_hint, notified, sample_id)
SELECT fingerprint, rule_id, level, description, agent, srcip, "user", groups, first_seen, last_seen, COALESCE(count, 1), verdict, reason, fp_percent, summary, intel, suppress_hint, COALESCE(notified, false), sample_id
FROM jsonb_to_recordset($1::jsonb) AS r(fingerprint text, rule_id text, level int, description text, agent text, srcip text, "user" text, groups text, first_seen timestamptz, last_seen timestamptz, count int, verdict text, reason text, fp_percent int, summary text, intel text, suppress_hint text, notified boolean, sample_id text)
ON CONFLICT (fingerprint) DO UPDATE SET
  rule_id = EXCLUDED.rule_id, level = EXCLUDED.level, description = EXCLUDED.description, agent = EXCLUDED.agent,
  srcip = EXCLUDED.srcip, "user" = EXCLUDED."user", groups = EXCLUDED.groups,
  first_seen = LEAST(w.first_seen, EXCLUDED.first_seen),
  last_seen = GREATEST(w.last_seen, EXCLUDED.last_seen),
  count = w.count + EXCLUDED.count,
  verdict = EXCLUDED.verdict, reason = EXCLUDED.reason,
  fp_percent = COALESCE(EXCLUDED.fp_percent, w.fp_percent),
  summary = COALESCE(NULLIF(EXCLUDED.summary, ''), w.summary),
  intel = COALESCE(NULLIF(EXCLUDED.intel, ''), w.intel),
  suppress_hint = COALESCE(NULLIF(EXCLUDED.suppress_hint, ''), w.suppress_hint),
  notified = w.notified OR EXCLUDED.notified,
  sample_id = EXCLUDED.sample_id;
DELETE FROM wazuh_alerts WHERE last_seen < now() - interval '90 days';
SELECT fingerprint, rule_id, description, agent, verdict, count, suppress_hint FROM wazuh_alerts WHERE last_seen >= now() - interval '24 hours';

nodeGroups.name: Dedupe and suppress
nodeGroups.description: Fingerprint alerts, apply wazuh_suppress rules, skip repeats (Postgres wazuh_alerts), collapse bursts.

nodeGroups.name: Enrich and LLM triage
nodeGroups.description: IP Threat Intel for new external IPs (4 per poll, 24h cache), Ollama FP score, verdict rules.

nodeGroups.name: Record
nodeGroups.description: Atomic upsert per fingerprint into Postgres wazuh_alerts.

nodeGroups.name: Advance cursor
nodeGroups.description: Runs last; only advances after processing succeeds.

nodeGroups.name: Daily digest
nodeGroups.description: Prune rows older than 90 days, then verdict counts and noisiest rules.
